flows.title: Create and name a site
steps: At the top, under "Start a new site," select a template.
At the top left, enter the name of the site and press Enter.
At the top right, click Publish.

flows.title: Make a copy of a site
steps: Open the site you want to copy in Google Sites.
In the top right, click More, then Make a copy.
Under "File name," enter a name for the copy.
Optional: to change where the copy is kept, click Change.
Click OK. A large site may not copy.

flows.title: Restore an earlier version of a site
steps: Browsing a site's version history needs permission to edit that site, and version history is available only for some sites.
In the top right, click More, then Version history.
In the right sidebar, click Expand detailed versions.
Choose the earlier version you want.
At the top left, click Restore this site version, then Restore. To return to the current version, at the top left click Back.
